svg.title: JGDMS proxy lifecycle — export to dynamic grant
svg.desc: Six-phase proxy lifecycle: service export, SCAP gate, ClassLoader provisioning, authentication, getServiceProxy, and dynamic grant via VerifyingProxyPreparer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Phase 1 service export including AtomicILFactory and JoinManager')
g.text: ① Service export & registration
ServiceStarter → NonActivatableServiceDescriptor.create()
ExportClassLoader created (importCodebase + exportCodebase URLs)
Startable.start() → BasicJeriExporter.export() → AtomicILFactory creates dynamic Proxy
ProxyCodebaseSpi.record(service, handler, loader) → stored in SERVICES_EXP cache
JoinManager: multicast discovery → registers ServiceItem in lookup services

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Phase 2 the SCAP gate before proxy unmarshalling')
g.text: ② SCAP gate (before any unmarshal)
ServiceDiscoveryManager discovers lookup service via multicast
registrarPreparer.prepareProxy(registrar) → trust verified
ProxyCodebaseSpi: hash JAR → SHA-256 → query Host 3 getVerdictByHash()
SAFE RegistryVerdict required → proceed · DANGEROUS or absent → refuse · log · alert
BAE verdicts: ClinitBlockingVisitor · AtomicSerialComplianceVisitor · cycle detector

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Phase 3 ClassLoader provisioning including the four-path decision and cache key')
g.text: ③ ClassLoader provisioning (PreferredProxyCodebaseProvider)
Cache key: (InvocationHandler, List<Uri> codebase, ClassLoader parent)
InvocationHandler encodes authenticated remote endpoint — two services sharing a
JAR on different hosts get DIFFERENT ClassLoaders and independent ProtectionDomains
Path 1 — boomerang: SERVICES_EXP hit → use export ClassLoader (no download)
Path 2 — self-unmarshal: loaderAnnotation == codebase → use parent ClassLoader
Path 3 — cached: CACHE hit → use cached ClassLoader (STRONG key / WEAK value / 60s)
Path 4 — new: verify JAR (encodedCerts or verifyCodebaseIntegrity) → new PreferredClassLoader

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Phase 4 proxy authentication including MinPrincipal and SPIFFE identity establishment')
g.text: ④ Bootstrap proxy authentication
bootstrapProxyPreparer.prepareProxy(bootstrapProxy)
bootstrapProxy = [CodebaseAccessor, RemoteMethodControl]
setConstraints(mc) → MinPrincipal authentication happens here
SPIFFE identity (SAN from SVID) established as proxy Principal
This is the security boundary — proxy identity known before any grant

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Phase 5 getServiceProxy and ProxySerializer unmarshalling')
g.text: ⑤ Full smart proxy download & unmarshal
ServiceItemFilter.check() → bootstrapProxy.getServiceProxy() (remote call)
Stream contains ProxySerializer {bootstrapProxy, AtomicMarshalledInstance serviceProxy}
AtomicSerial GetArg constructor validates before any field is set
serviceProxy.get(loader, true, verifier, context) → typed smart proxy
StringMethodConstraints.combine() merges proxy constraints with client constraints
Prepared proxy stored as ServiceItemReg.filteredItem (defensive clone)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Phase 6 the dynamic grant via VerifyingProxyPreparer and Security.grant')
g.text: ⑥ Dynamic grant (VerifyingProxyPreparer)
Security.verifyObjectTrust(proxy, loader, context) — trust verification
If preparer has explicit Permission[] → Security.grant(klass, permissions)
If preparer has no permissions → advisory path:
ClassLoader ldr = proxy.getClass().getClassLoader()
if (ldr instanceof AdvisoryDynamicPermissions) → ldr.getPermissions() → Security.grant()
Security.grant() → DynamicPolicyProvider.grant() enforces GrantPermission ceiling
UnsupportedOperationException: explicit path → SecurityException · advisory path → log only
Principal[] null → uses preparing thread's Subject (SPIFFE identity of client)
Grant scoped to proxy.getClass() + principals → stored in DynamicPolicyProvider

svg.text: Proxy abandoned → ClassLoader CACHE entry clears (Ref.WEAK 60s TTL)
→ lazy it.remove() on next iterator pass over dynamicPolicyGrants
